createProject.description: Start a new novel, short story, or any writing project from this button.

account.title: User account

projectCard.description: Find the cover, genre, description, and progress for the project.

openProject.title: Open project
openProject.description: This button opens the full workspace for the selected project.

replay.title: Replay the tour
replay.description: You can view this home page tour again at any time.

brand.title: Papyrus
brand.description: Your writing studio centralizes the manuscript, sheets, and project tools.

currentProject.title: Current project
currentProject.description: This area shows the open project and lets you return to the project list.

navigation.title: Project navigation
navigation.description: The sidebar gives you access to every section of your universe and manuscript.

navDashboard.title: Dashboard
navDashboard.description: Track global progress, goals, activity, and creation shortcuts.

navCharacters.title: Characters
navCharacters.description: Create detailed character sheets and keep their evolution consistent.

navChapters.title: Chapters
navChapters.description: Organize parts, open the editor, and write your manuscript.

navResearch.title: Research
navResearch.description: Store sources, links, images, videos, files, and documentation notes.

navGoals.title: Goals
navGoals.description: Set word or progress goals and track their status.

header.title: Top bar
header.description: Find the project title, connection status, and helpful actions like this tour.

dashboardSummary.title: Quick statistics
dashboardSummary.description: These cards give an immediate view of your progress.

dashboardGoals.title: Current goals
dashboardGoals.description: Keep open goals and their progress in sight.

dashboardProgress.title: Progress
dashboardProgress.description: View important writing and world-building indicators.

dashboardActivity.title: Recent activity
dashboardActivity.description: Find the latest creations and updates in the project.

quickActions.title: Quick actions
quickActions.description: Create a character, chapter, place, object, event, or note directly.

writingStreak.title: Writing streak
writingStreak.description: Track your writing streak and daily goal.

pageContent.title: Workspace
pageContent.description: Each section displays its lists, forms, details, and dedicated tools here.

replay.title: Replay the tour
replay.description: This button lets you view the deeper project tour again.

characters.openDescription: Let’s move to the character sheet section.
characters.title: Characters
characters.description: Create, organize, and view the characters in your story with their detailed information.

places.openDescription: Let’s move to the places that shape your story world.
places.title: Places
places.description: Describe places, atmosphere, population, and narrative role.

objects.openDescription: Let’s move to the important objects in your story.
objects.title: Objects
objects.description: Track objects, artifacts, and significant elements in your universe.

chapters.openDescription: Let’s move to manuscript organization and writing.
chapters.title: Chapters
chapters.description: Structure parts, select a chapter, and open the editor to write.

research.title: Research
research.description: Centralize sources, links, media, files, and notes useful to the project.

timeline.openDescription: Let’s move to your story events.
timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: Place events in time and connect them to chapters when needed.

structure.openDescription: Let’s move to the narrative foundations of the project.
structure.title: Structure
structure.description: Define the theme, premise, narrative goals, and overall structure.

mindMaps.title: Mind maps
mindMaps.description: Visualize ideas, relationships, and branches as maps.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Keep ideas, reminders, and work fragments available at any time.

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: Create goals and track their progress, urgency, and status.

export.title: Export
export.description: Choose what to export and prepare a readable version of your project.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure appearance, autosave, notifications, shortcuts, and preferences.

header.title: Characters view
header.description: This page gathers your project characters and helps you keep their information consistent.

create.title: New character
create.description: Create a complete profile with identity, physical description, personality, relationships, notes, and avatar.

list.title: List and search
list.description: Filter characters, select a profile, then edit or delete items directly from their cards.

detail.title: Detailed profile
detail.description: The right panel shows the selected profile with its sections, story information, and actions.

header.title: Places view
header.description: This page gathers the important locations in your world, from description to story purpose.

create.title: New place
create.description: Add a setting, city, country, or key location with details, population, and atmosphere.

list.title: List and search
list.description: Quickly find a place with search, then open its profile from the list.

detail.title: Place details
detail.description: Review the description, traits, and useful information before reusing the place in scenes.

header.title: Objects view
header.description: This page tracks objects, artifacts, resources, and symbolic elements in your story.

create.title: New object
create.description: Create an object profile with its type, appearance, importance, and optional avatar.

list.title: List and search
list.description: Browse existing objects, select one, or use the quick actions on each card.

detail.title: Object details
detail.description: The detail panel keeps the selected object’s purpose, properties, and narrative role visible.

header.title: Notes view
header.description: This page stores free ideas, reminders, scene fragments, and thoughts to revisit later.

create.title: New note
create.description: Add a standalone note, with or without a file, so ideas are not lost while writing.

list.title: Notes list
list.description: Notes appear as cards that are easy to open, edit, or delete.

detail.title: Note reading
detail.description: When a note is selected, its content and attachments are displayed in this panel.

header.title: Research view
header.description: This page centralizes your documentation: sources, links, media, books, files, and comments.

create.title: New research item
create.description: Add a documentation resource, local file, or useful link for your world.

filters.title: Search and categories
filters.description: Filter by text or resource type to quickly find the right reference.

list.title: Saved resources
list.description: Each card lets you open, download, edit, or delete a resource depending on its format.

header.title: Timeline view
header.description: This page organizes story events over time and helps check continuity.

create.title: New event
create.description: Add a date, importance, location, and optionally a linked chapter.

list.title: Timeline
list.description: The left side shows ordered events so you can read the plot progression.

detail.title: Details or form
detail.description: The right side is used to view, create, or edit the selected event.

header.title: Chapters view
header.description: This page connects manuscript structure with the actual writing of each chapter.

actions.title: Create parts and chapters
actions.description: Add a part to organize the manuscript or create a chapter directly, even without a part.

overview.title: Manuscript summary
overview.description: These counters give a quick view of parts, chapters, and written words.

tree.title: Parts tree
tree.description: Expand parts to see chapters, change the selection, and access actions.

detail.title: Chapter details
detail.description: After selecting a chapter, read its summary, check word count, and open the editor.

header.title: Structure view
header.description: This page defines your story foundations before and during drafting.

tabs.title: Structure tabs
tabs.description: Switch between concept, plan, and narrative objectives depending on your preparation level.

content.title: Editable content
content.description: Enable editing to adjust the premise, genre, theme, structure, or objectives.

header.title: Mind maps view
header.description: This page helps organize ideas visually and explore links between concepts.

canvas.title: Create a map
canvas.description: Start a new mind map for characters, places, plots, or systems.

list.title: Existing maps
list.description: Find your maps, open them for editing, or delete the ones you no longer need.

header.title: Goals view
header.description: This page tracks your writing goals and their status based on deadlines.

create.title: New goal
create.description: Create a daily, weekly, monthly, or project goal with a progress unit.

stats.title: Statistics cards
stats.description: These cards summarize active, daily, completed goals and average progress.

filters.title: Type filters
filters.description: Show all goals or limit the view to one frequency.

active.title: Active goals
active.description: Track open goals, progress, status, and available actions.

completed.title: Completed goals
completed.description: Completed goals remain visible in history so you can keep track of progress.

header.title: Export view
header.description: This page prepares a readable version of the project to download or share.

formats.title: Available formats
formats.description: Choose the right file type: PDF, Word, EPUB, or plain text.

preview.title: Export preview
preview.description: Check the chosen format, chapters, word count, and estimated pages.

options.title: Annexes
options.description: Add character, place, object, event, note, or research sheets at the end of the document.

header.title: Settings view
header.description: This page gathers project and app preferences.

actions.title: Reset or save
actions.description: The top buttons let you cancel changes or save the settings.

tabs.title: Settings categories
tabs.description: Move between general, appearance, shortcuts, and notifications.

panel.title: Active settings
panel.description: The right panel displays the options for the selected category.
